description: Raw poppy tar, worked into a brown pellet. Older than every other thing on this list put together.

effects.comeon_message: The first of it arrives as warmth behind the breastbone, and takes its time about the rest.
effects.onset_message: The warmth finishes arriving. Nothing hurts. Nothing is urgent. You could sit here until the building comes down.

overdose.message: Your breathing gets slower and further apart, and then it stops bothering.

phases.end_message: The warmth drains off by degrees, the way a room cools. You are left sitting in the shape of it.
phases.peak_message: You settle into it. The world is still going on and it is doing so at a polite distance.

effects.take_line: You worry a lump of {name} off the pellet and chew it down. It tastes like a hedge burning.

withdrawal.message: Everything aches at once, evenly, like weather. You know exactly what would fix it.

stages.easing: You get a whole afternoon back. You spend a good part of it deciding whether you have got away with it.
stages.onset: You yawn until your jaw clicks, and it is not tiredness, and you know it is not.
stages.peak: Your legs will not settle anywhere. You try the bed, the floor, the chair and the floor again, and every one of them is wrong in a way you cannot explain to anybody.
stages.rising: Cold, then sweating, then cold, and a low ache in both shins that has been there since morning without ever once being sharp enough to name.
stages.tail: Sleeping. Eating. Upright. And every so often a warm room or a certain smell puts the whole thing in front of you, fully formed, like it was waiting.

name: opium
